图片内文字：
- Guidance for local CDO teams
- Boehringer has contractual obligations to continue trials until sponsorship and operational transfer can be completed or until completion of trial (i.e. -0120 and -0140)
- Boehringer is reimbursed for clinical development costs of trials. Any changes to trial costs requires Leo consent.
- Resources must be maintained for trials until operational transfer at the country level can be completed or until trial completion. First transition to start in Q1-2026 with -0025.
- Countries should familiarize on process for sponsorship transfer at country level and validate plans by end-Aug
- Local CDO teams are required to complete GPP Post Marketing study (-0120) and PG Ph III study (-0140) until LPO including close-out visits
- Contact country transition lead for any questions related to trial transition.
- Terminated HS and NS trials will be completed as planned with no transition.
- Boehringer Ingelheim
- PGL-36 | ONLY FOR INTERNAL USE
- 46

视觉关系：
- 项目/试验与时间节点关系：指出“First transition to start in Q1-2026 with -0025”（首次transition在2026年Q1开始，关联试验/项目为-0025）。
- 计划/流程约束关系：
  - 试验需持续进行，直到“sponsorship and operational transfer can be completed”或“completion of trial”（并举例 i.e. -0120 and -0140）。
  - 资源维持需持续到“operational transfer at the country level can be completed”或“trial completion”。
  - 国家层面需要“familiarize on process for sponsorship transfer… and validate plans by end-Aug”（在end-Aug前完成计划验证）。
  - 本地CDO团队需完成指定研究（GPP Post Marketing study -0120；PG Ph III study -0140）直到LPO（包含close-out visits）。
  - “Terminated HS and NS trials”与transition关系：这些试验“no transition”（无转移），但仍“completed as planned”。
